agent.name: Job Assistant
agent.tagline: Takes a remodeling job from first call to signed bid, using Dana's own rules at every step.

can: Turn site-visit notes and photos into a scope
Build line-item estimates from your price sheet
wont: Send anything to a client itself
Say work meets code or needs no permit
Make up a price that isn't in your price sheet
asks_first: Before any price or proposal goes to a client
Before using a price sheet older than 4 weeks
expert_checks: Permits and code → check with the city
Asbestos, lead paint, gas, or panel work → stop and flag

stages.title: Intake
stages.summary: A new lead calls, emails, or fills in the web form

steps.title: A lead comes in
steps.detail: You paste the email or call notes, or say "new lead".

steps.title: Decides if it's a fit
steps.detail: Checks job type, size, location, and urgency against your rules.
rules: Under $2,500 → refer to the handyman list
Outside the service area → decline kindly
Water damage or mold → urgent, visit within 48 hours
open: Do we take small commercial jobs?

branch.then: Drafts a friendly decline with a referral for you to send.

steps.title: Site visit request drafted
steps.detail: A reply proposing visit times, and a new job file.

stages.passes_on: Client, address, year built, job type, rough budget, urgency

stages.title: Site visit & scope
stages.summary: You visit, then share notes and photos

steps.title: Reads your notes and photos
steps.detail: Pulls out measurements, conditions, and what the client asked for.

steps.title: Checks for expert calls
steps.detail: Looks for structural, hazard, and permit questions.
rules: Wall removal or new openings → structural flag
House built before 1978 → possible lead paint flag

branch.then: Flags it and says who to ask, instead of pricing around it.

steps.title: Scope of work
steps.detail: Rooms, tasks, inclusions, exclusions, and open questions for you.

stages.passes_on: Scope line items, measurements, flags, exclusions

stages.title: Estimate

steps.title: Prices it from your price sheet
steps.detail: Materials from price-sheet.md, labor at your crew rates.

branch.when: If the price sheet is over 4 weeks old
branch.then: Warns you and asks before using it.

steps.title: Applies your markup and contingency
steps.detail: Uses the playbook, not general rules of thumb.

steps.title: Line-item estimate
steps.detail: A table with subtotals, contingency, total, and the assumptions it used.

stages.passes_on: Line items, total, assumptions, contingency used

stages.title: Bid / proposal
stages.summary: A proposal ready for your review

steps.title: Writes the proposal
steps.detail: Your standard terms, exclusions, payment schedule, and timeline.

steps.title: Waits for your OK
steps.detail: Shows you the full proposal. Nothing goes to the client without your yes.

steps.title: You get a ready-to-send proposal
steps.detail: Plus a cover email in your voice, and the job file updated to "Bid sent".

stages.passes_on: Job status, total, date sent, follow-up date
